title: Decision-ready human review event
description: One blinded reviewer event on one decision-ready artifact (R6, plan docs/dev/plans/2026-10-15-02-decision-ready-triage-plan.md Task 7). An event binds to an artifact only by the sha256 digest of the artifact's canonical decision-artifact.json bytes — never by file name, case path, ticket id, or reviewer identity. Reviewers are anonymous pseudonymous session ids at most; anything identifying a person or a private tracker must never appear in this document.

artifact_digest.description: sha256 digest of the reviewed decision-artifact/1 canonical JSON (decision-artifact.json).

started_at.description: RFC 3339 / ISO-8601 timestamp with offset (Z or ±hh:mm). Wall-clock start of the review.

finished_at.description: End of review; finished_at must be >= started_at.

accepted.description: Reviewer selected Accept. false = Reject (including returning the artifact for remediation work).

environment_answers.description: Answers to the artifact's declared environment questions (0..2). An answer is never a code-level claim; it is an EnvironmentAssertion input.

variable.description: Declared DecisionVariable id from the artifact (e.g. deployment_perimeter).

value.description: One of the variable's allowed_values, or the literal "unknown".

mandatory_fact_refs_read.description: Fact ids from human_action.mandatory_fact_refs the reviewer actually opened/read.

repository_open_count.description: How many times the reviewer opened the product repository/sources. Must be 0 for the decision-ready contract.

tool_rerun_count.description: How many times the reviewer re-ran an analysis/evidence tool. Must be 0 for the decision-ready contract.

technical_follow_up_count.description: Technical follow-up questions the reviewer needed beyond declared environment questions.

returned_for_remediation.description: Reviewer sent the artifact back for more work instead of accepting/rejecting the proposal as presented.

reopened.description: The artifact's decision was later reopened/reversed (reversal of an accepted decision).

initial_branch_id.description: Optional: branch the artifact's own evaluation selected before the reviewer's environment answers were applied.

selected_branch_id.description: Optional: branch selected after the reviewer's environment answers. Compared against initial_branch_id for the branch-change-after-answer rate.

reviewer_session.description: Optional pseudonymous reviewer session token for inter-reviewer agreement analysis. Never a name, email, or employee id.
